_comment: Spot-only Halal crypto registry. Only utility / store-of-value assets traded spot. Leverage, yield-bearing and interest-linked products are excluded by design: this scanner does not support margin, derivatives or DeFi lending.
_denylist_reason: Interest/algorithmic-backed or fiat-collateralised stablecoins are excluded from this scanner's default Halal spot set. They may be permitted by some fiqh committees (subject to asset backing) and by AAOIFI Shariah Standard 59; a user who follows that view should add the ticker to allowed_spot_cryptos and remove it from denylisted_symbols.
_symbol_note: Symbols are Yahoo Finance spot pairs. Polygon trades on Yahoo as POL28321-USD (POL-USD does not resolve).
